title: WhyStrohm foundrkit rules, v1
description: A brand's checkable voice rules. Written to brand/foundrkit.rules.json by foundrkit-lint --from-brand, from brand/voice-profile.json and brand/brand-lock.md, or by hand. Read by foundrkit-lint. The canonical copy lives in github.com/whystrohm/shotkit under contracts/. Other repos keep a byte-identical copy, and CI checks it.

generated_from.description: The files the rules were built from, relative to the project folder. Empty or absent for hand-written rules.

pattern.description: A plain phrase, or a regex written as /body/flags.
